problem_description.description: The leader of some very secretive organization has decided to invite all other members to a meeting. All members of the organization live in the same town which can be represented as $$$n$$$ crossroads connected by $$$m$$$ two-directional streets. The meeting will be held in the leader's house near the crossroad $$$1$$$. There are $$$k$$$ members of the organization invited to the meeting; $$$i$$$-th of them lives near the crossroad $$$a_i$$$. All members of the organization receive the message about the meeting at the same moment and start moving to the location where the meeting is held. In the beginning of each minute each person is located at some crossroad. He or she can either wait a minute at this crossroad, or spend a minute to walk from the current crossroad along some street to another crossroad (obviously, it is possible to start walking along the street only if it begins or ends at the current crossroad). In the beginning of the first minute each person is at the crossroad where he or she lives. As soon as a person reaches the crossroad number $$$1$$$, he or she immediately comes to the leader's house and attends the meeting.Obviously, the leader wants all other members of the organization to come up as early as possible. But, since the organization is very secretive, the leader does not want to attract much attention. Let's denote the discontent of the leader as follows  initially the discontent is $$$0$$$;  whenever a person reaches the crossroad number $$$1$$$, the discontent of the leader increases by $$$c \cdot x$$$, where $$$c$$$ is some fixed constant, and $$$x$$$ is the number of minutes it took the person to reach the crossroad number $$$1$$$;  whenever $$$x$$$ members of the organization walk along the same street at the same moment in the same direction, $$$dx^2$$$ is added to the discontent, where $$$d$$$ is some fixed constant. This is not cumulative: for example, if two persons are walking along the same street in the same direction at the same moment, then $$$4d$$$ is added to the discontent, not $$$5d$$$. Before sending a message about the meeting, the leader can tell each member of the organization which path they should choose and where they should wait. Help the leader to establish a plan for every member of the organization so they all reach the crossroad $$$1$$$, and the discontent is minimized.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of the input contains five integer numbers $$$n$$$, $$$m$$$, $$$k$$$, $$$c$$$ and $$$d$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 50$$$, $$$n - 1 \le m \le 50$$$, $$$1 \le k, c, d \le 50$$$) — the number of crossroads, the number of streets, the number of persons invited to the meeting and the constants affecting the discontent, respectively. The second line contains $$$k$$$ numbers $$$a_1$$$, $$$a_2$$$, ..., $$$a_k$$$ ($$$2 \le a_i \le n$$$) — the crossroads where the members of the organization live. Then $$$m$$$ lines follow, each denoting a bidirectional street. Each line contains two integers $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$ ($$$1 \le x_i, y_i \le n$$$, $$$x_i \ne y_i$$$) denoting a street connecting crossroads $$$x_i$$$ and $$$y_i$$$. There may be multiple streets connecting the same pair of crossroads. It is guaranteed that every crossroad can be reached from every other crossroad using the given streets.
problem_description.output_spec: Print one integer: the minimum discontent of the leader after everyone reaches crossroad $$$1$$$.
problem_description.notes: NoteThe best course of action in the first test is the following:  the first person goes along the street $$$2$$$ to the crossroad $$$2$$$, then goes along the street $$$1$$$ to the crossroad $$$1$$$ and attends the meeting;  the second person waits one minute on the crossroad $$$3$$$, then goes along the street $$$2$$$ to the crossroad $$$2$$$, then goes along the street $$$1$$$ to the crossroad $$$1$$$ and attends the meeting;  the third person waits two minutes on the crossroad $$$3$$$, then goes along the street $$$2$$$ to the crossroad $$$2$$$, then goes along the street $$$1$$$ to the crossroad $$$1$$$ and attends the meeting;  the fourth person waits three minutes on the crossroad $$$3$$$, then goes along the street $$$2$$$ to the crossroad $$$2$$$, then goes along the street $$$1$$$ to the crossroad $$$1$$$ and attends the meeting.

import sys
from collections import deque

N = 10000
M = N * 100
inf = (1 << 63) - 1 >> 5

class FlowGraph:
    def __init__(self):
        self.head = [-1] * N
        self.v = [0] * M
        self.nxt = [-1] * M
        self.c = [0] * M
        self.w = [0] * M
        self.ptr = 0
        self.cost = 0
        self.t = 0

    def padd_edge(self, uu, vv, ww, cc):
        self.v[self.ptr] = vv
        self.w[self.ptr] = ww
        self.c[self.ptr] = cc
        self.nxt[self.ptr] = self.head[uu]
        self.head[uu] = self.ptr
        self.ptr += 1

    def add_edge(self, uu, vv, ww, cc):
        self.padd_edge(uu, vv, ww, cc)
        self.padd_edge(vv, uu, 0, -cc)

    def spfa(self, s, t):
        self.vis = [False] * N
        self.dis = [-1] * N
        self.id = [0] * N
        self.cur = [-1] * N
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)
        self.dis[s] = 0
        self.id[s] = 1
        while q:
            nd = q.popleft()
            self.vis[nd] = False
            i = self.head[nd]
            while i != -1:
                if self.w[i] and (self.dis[self.v[i]] == -1 or self.dis[self.v[i]] > self.dis[nd] + self.c[i]):
                    self.dis[self.v[i]] = self.dis[nd] + self.c[i]
                    if not self.vis[self.v[i]]:
                        self.vis[self.v[i]] = True
                        q.append(self.v[i])
                i = self.nxt[i]
        return self.dis[t] != -1

    def dfs(self, pos, flow, t):
        if pos == t:
            return flow
        self.vis[pos] = True
        tmp = flow
        i = self.cur[pos] if self.cur[pos] != -1 else self.head[pos]
        while i != -1:
            if not self.vis[self.v[i]] and self.w[i] and self.dis[self.v[i]] == self.dis[pos] + self.c[i]:
                self.cur[pos] = i
                fl = self.dfs(self.v[i], min(flow, self.w[i]), t)
                self.cost += fl * self.c[i]
                self.w[i] -= fl
                self.w[i ^ 1] += fl
                flow -= fl
                if flow == 0:
                    break
            i = self.nxt[i]
        return tmp - flow

    def dinic(self, s, t):
        self.cost = 0
        self.t = t
        while self.spfa(s, t):
            self.cur = [-1] * N
            self.vis = [False] * N
            self.dfs(s, inf, t)
        return self.cost

# Constants

INF = 0x3f3f3f3f

# Flow namespace as a class
class Flow:
    N = 50 * T + 2
    M = 2 * N * C + N + 7

    def __init__(self):
        self.par = [-1] * self.N
        self.first = [-1] * self.N
        self.nxt = [-1] * (2 * self.M)
        self.ep = [-1] * (2 * self.M)
        self.flo = [0] * (2 * self.M)
        self.cap = [0] * (2 * self.M)
        self.cost = [0] * (2 * self.M)
        self.m = 0

    def init(self):
        self.m = 0
        for i in range(self.N):
            self.first[i] = -1
        for i in range(len(self.flo)):
            self.flo[i] = 0

    def add_edge(self, a, b, c=1, p=0):
        e1 = self.m
        self.nxt[e1] = self.first[a]
        self.first[a] = e1
        self.ep[e1] = b
        self.cap[e1] = c
        self.cost[e1] = p
        self.m += 1

        e2 = self.m
        self.nxt[e2] = self.first[b]
        self.first[b] = e2
        self.ep[e2] = a
        self.cap[e2] = 0
        self.cost[e2] = -p
        self.m += 1

    def mcf_pot_init(self, n):
        self.pot = [0] * n
        for _ in range(1, n):
            for e in range(self.m):
                if self.cap[e]:
                    u = self.ep[e ^ 1]
                    v = self.ep[e]
                    self.pot[v] = min(self.pot[v], self.pot[u] + self.cost[e]) if self.pot[v] != 0 else self.pot[v]

    def mcf_update(self, s, t, price, n):
        INF_DIST = 10**15
        vis = [False] * n
        dist = [INF_DIST] * n
        inq = [-1] * n
        dist[s] = 0
        q = []
        heapq.heappush(q, (0, s))
        while q:
            d, u = heapq.heappop(q)
            if vis[u]:
                continue
            vis[u] = True
            for e in range(self.first[u], -1, self.nxt[e] if hasattr(self, 'nxt') else -1):
                v = self.ep[e]
                if self.cap[e] - self.flo[e] > 0:
                    nd = dist[u] + self.cost[e] + self.pot[u] - self.pot[v]
                    if nd < dist[v]:
                        dist[v] = nd
                        self.par[v] = e
                        heapq.heappush(q, (dist[v], v))
        if dist[t] == INF_DIST:
            return 0
        df = INF_DIST
        i = t
        while i != s:
            e = self.par[i]
            df = min(df, self.cap[e] - self.flo[e])
            i = self.ep[e ^ 1]
        i = t
        while i != s:
            e = self.par[i]
            self.flo[e] += df
            self.flo[e ^ 1] -= df
            price[0] += df * self.cost[e]
            i = self.ep[e ^ 1]
        for i in range(n):
            self.pot[i] = min(10**15, self.pot[i] + dist[i])
        return df

class Flow:
    N = 50 * T + 2

    class Edge:
        def __init__(self, v, r, f, c, p):
            self.v = v
            self.r = r
            self.f = f
            self.c = c
            self.p = p

    def __init__(self):
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(self.N)]
        self.sz = [0] * self.N
        self.mc = 0

    def init(self, n=None):
        if n is None:
            n = self.N
        self.mc = 0
        self.sz = [0] * n
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add_edge(self, a, b, c=1, p=0):
        self.mc = max(self.mc, c)
        self.adj[a].append(self.Edge(b, self.sz[b], 0, c, p))
        self.sz[b] += 1
        self.adj[b].append(self.Edge(a, self.sz[a], 0, 0, -p))
        self.sz[a] += 1

    def pot_init(self, n):
        self.pot = [0] * n
        for i in range(1, n):
            for u in range(n):
                for e in self.adj[u]:
                    if e.c:
                        self.pot[e.v] = min(self.pot[e.v], self.pot[u] + e.p)

    def mcf(self, s, t, price, n, sparse, lb=1):
        vis = [False] * n
        dist = [INF] * n
        par = [0] * n
        dist[s] = 0
        if sparse:
            # SPFA
            dk = []
            heapq.heappush(dk, (0, s))
            while dk:
                d, u = heapq.heappop(dk)
                if vis[u]:
                    continue
                vis[u] = True
                for e in self.adj[u]:
                    if e.f <= e.c - lb and dist[e.v] > dist[u] + self.pot[u] - self.pot[e.v] + e.p:
                        dist[e.v] = dist[u] + self.pot[u] - self.pot[e.v] + e.p
                        par[e.v] = e.r
                        heapq.heappush(dk, (-dist[e.v], e.v))
        else:
            # Dense
            for _ in range(n):
                u = -1
                best = INF
                for i in range(n):
                    if not vis[i] and dist[i] < best:
                        best = dist[i]
                        u = i
                if u == -1:
                    break
                vis[u] = True
                for e in self.adj[u]:
                    if e.f <= e.c - lb and dist[e.v] > dist[u] + self.pot[u] - self.pot[e.v] + e.p:
                        dist[e.v] = dist[u] + self.pot[u] - self.pot[e.v] + e.p
                        par[e.v] = e.r
        if dist[t] >= INF:
            return 0
        df = INF
        u = t
        while u != s:
            r = self.adj[u][par[u]]
            df = min(df, self.adj[r.v][r.r].c - self.adj[r.v][r.r].f)
            u = r.v
        u = t
        while u != s:
            r = self.adj[u][par[u]]
            e = self.adj[r.v][r.r]
            e.f += df
            self.adj[r.v][r.r] = e
            rev = self.adj[u][r.r]
            rev.f -= df
            self.adj[u][r.r] = rev
            price[0] += df * e.p
            u = r.v
        for i in range(n):
            self.pot[i] = min(INF, dist[i] + self.pot[i])
        return df

    def min_cost_flow(self, s, t, price, n=None, sparse=False):
        if n is None:
            n = self.N
        self.pot_init(n)
        flow = 0
        price[0] = 0
        lb = 1 << 30
        while lb > 0:
            while True:
                df = self.mcf(s, t, price, n, sparse, lb)
                if df == 0:
                    break
                flow += df
            lb //= 2
        return flow

                v = u
        return flow, flowcost

class MCF:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.u = [0] * n
        self.v = [0] * n
        self.prio = [0] * n
        self.curflow = [0] * n
        self.prevedge = [0] * n
        self.prevnode = [0] * n
        self.pot = [0] * n
        self.adj = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        
    class Edge:
        def __init__(self, to, f, cap, cost, rev):
            self.to = to
            self.f = f
            self.cap = cap
            self.cost = cost
            self.rev = rev

    def addEdge(self, s, t, cap, cost):
        a = self.Edge(t, 0, cap, cost, len(self.adj[t]))
        b = self.Edge(s, 0, 0, -cost, len(self.adj[s]))
        self.adj[s].append(a)
        self.adj[t].append(b)

    def minCostFlow(self, s, t):
        flow = 0
        flowCost = 0
        INF = 10**9
        while True:
            self.prio = [float('inf')] * self.n
            self.prio[s] = 0
            self.curflow = [float('inf')] * self.n
            q = []
            heapq.heappush(q, (0, s))
            while q:
                d, u = heapq.heappop(q)
                if d != self.prio[u]:
                    continue
                for i, e in enumerate(self.adj[u]):
                    v = e.to
                    if e.cap <= e.f:
                        continue
                    nprio = self.prio[u] + e.cost + self.pot[u] - self.pot[v]
                    if self.prio[v] > nprio:
                        self.prio[v] = nprio
                        heapq.heappush(q, (nprio, v))
                        self.prevnode[v] = u
                        self.prevedge[v] = i
                        self.curflow[v] = min(self.curflow[u], e.cap - e.f)
            if self.prio[t] == float('inf'):
                break
            for i in range(self.n):
                self.pot[i] += self.prio[i]
            df = min(self.curflow[t], INF - flow)
            flow += df
            v = t
            while v != s:
                u = self.prevnode[v]
                e = self.adj[u][self.prevedge[v]]
                e.f += df
                self.adj[v][e.rev].f -= df
                flowCost += df * e.cost
                v = u
        return flow, flowCost

def min_cost_max_flow(graph, s, t):
    flow = 0
    cost = 0
    n = len(graph)
    dist = [0] * n
    potential = [0] * n
    parent = [[-1, -1] for _ in range(n)]  # [node, edge_index]

    # Bellman-Ford for initial potentials
    for _ in range(n):
        updated = False
        for u in range(n):
            for i, (v, cap, cst, rev) in enumerate(graph[u]):
                if cap > 0 and potential[u] + cst < potential[v]:
                    potential[v] = potential[u] + cst
                    updated = True
        if not updated:
            break

        dist = [math.inf] * n
        dist[s] = 0
        parent = [[-1, -1] for _ in range(n)]
        heap = [(0, s)]
        while heap:
            d, u = heapq.heappop(heap)
            if d > dist[u]:
                continue
            for i, (v, cap, cst, rev) in enumerate(graph[u]):
                if cap > 0:
                    nd = d + cst + potential[u] - potential[v]
                    if nd < dist[v]:
                        dist[v] = nd
                        parent[v] = [u, i]
                        heapq.heappush(heap, (nd, v))
        if dist[t] == math.inf:
            break
        for i in range(n):
            if dist[i] < math.inf:
                potential[i] += dist[i]
        # Augment flow
        add_flow = math.inf
        v = t
        while v != s:
            u, i = parent[v]
            add_flow = min(add_flow, graph[u][i][1])
            v = u
        v = t

            rev = graph[u][i][3]
            v2 = graph[v][rev][0]
            graph[v][rev][1] += add_flow
            cost += add_flow * graph[u][i][2]
            v = u
        flow += add_flow
    return flow, cost

import heapq

class MinCostFlow:
    class Edge:
        def __init__(self, v, c, w, r):
            self.v = v
            self.c = c
            self.w = w
            self.r = r

    def __init__(self, n):
        self.G = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add(self, u, v, c, w):
        i = len(self.G[u])
        j = len(self.G[v])
        self.G[u].append(self.Edge(v, c, w, j))
        self.G[v].append(self.Edge(u, 0, -w, i))

    def run(self, s, t, f):
        N = len(self.G)
        res = 0
        H = [0] * N
        D = [0] * N
        INF = 10**18
        PE = [0] * N
        PV = [0] * N
        while f > 0:
            q = []
            for i in range(N):
                D[i] = INF
            D[s] = 0
            heapq.heappush(q, (0, s))
            while q:
                d, u = heapq.heappop(q)
                d = -d
                if D[u] < d:
                    continue
                for i, e in enumerate(self.G[u]):
                    if e.c > 0 and D[e.v] > D[u] + e.w + H[u] - H[e.v]:
                        D[e.v] = D[u] + e.w + H[u] - H[e.v]
                        heapq.heappush(q, (-D[e.v], e.v))
                        PV[e.v] = u
                        PE[e.v] = i
            if D[t] == INF:
                return -1
            for i in range(N):
                H[i] += D[i]
            d = f
            i = t
            while i != s:
                u = PV[i]
                e = self.G[u][PE[i]]
                d = min(d, e.c)
                i = u
            f -= d
            res += d * H[t]
            i = t
            while i != s:
                u = PV[i]
                e = self.G[u][PE[i]]
                e.c -= d
                self.G[i][e.r].c += d
                i = u
        return res

from collections import deque

class MCMF:
    def __init__(self, N=30000, M=7010010):
        self.N = N
        self.M = M
        self.h = [-1] * N
        self.ing = [0] * N
        self.pre = [0] * N
        self.to = [0] * M
        self.ne = [0] * M
        self.cap = [0] * M
        self.dis = [float('inf')] * N
        self.cost = [0] * M
        self.e = 0
        self.s = 0
        self.t = 0
        self.n = 0

    def ini(self, _n=30000):
        self.n = _n
        self.h = [-1] * self.n
        self.e = 0

    def liu(self, u, v, c, w):
        self.to[self.e] = v
        self.ne[self.e] = self.h[u]
        self.cap[self.e] = c
        self.cost[self.e] = w
        self.h[u] = self.e
        self.e += 1

    def link(self, u, v, c, w):
        self.liu(u, v, c, w)
        self.liu(v, u, 0, -w)

    def spfa(self):
        Q = deque()
        self.dis = [float('inf')] * self.n
        self.ing = [0] * self.n
        self.pre = [-1] * self.n
        self.dis[self.s] = 0
        Q.append(self.s)
        self.ing[self.s] = 1
        while Q:
            c = Q.popleft()
            self.ing[c] = 0
            k = self.h[c]
            while k != -1:
                v = self.to[k]
                if self.cap[k] > 0 and self.dis[c] + self.cost[k] < self.dis[v]:
                    self.dis[v] = self.dis[c] + self.cost[k]
                    self.pre[v] = k
                    if not self.ing[v]:
                        Q.append(v)
                        self.ing[v] = 1
                k = self.ne[k]
        return self.dis[self.t] != float('inf')

    def run(self, _s, _t):
        self.s = _s
        self.t = _t
        flow = 0
        mincost = 0
        while self.spfa():
            pl = float('inf')
            p = self.t
            while p != self.s:
                k = self.pre[p]
                pl = min(pl, self.cap[k])
                p = self.to[k ^ 1]
            p = self.t
            while p != self.s:
                k = self.pre[p]
                self.cap[k] -= pl
                self.cap[k ^ 1] += pl
                p = self.to[k ^ 1]
            mincost += pl * self.dis[self.t]
            flow += pl
        return flow, mincost

class Edge:

class MinCostMaxFlow:
    def __init__(self):
        self.V = 0
        self.G = []

    def init(self, n):
        self.V = n
        self.G = [[] for _ in range(n)]

    def add_edge(self, from_, to, cap, cost):
        self.G[from_].append(Edge(to, cap, cost, len(self.G[to])))
        self.G[to].append(Edge(from_, 0, -cost, len(self.G[from_]) - 1))

    def min_cost(self, s, t, f):
        flow = 0
        res = 0
        H = [0] * self.V
        dis = [0] * self.V
        PreV = [0] * self.V
        PreE = [0] * self.V

        while f > 0:
            q = []
            for i in range(self.V):
                dis[i] = float('inf')
            dis[s] = 0
            heapq.heappush(q, (0, s))
            while q:
                now_dist, v = heapq.heappop(q)
                if dis[v] < now_dist:
                    continue
                for i, e in enumerate(self.G[v]):
                    if e.capacity > 0 and dis[e.to] > dis[v] + e.cost + H[v] - H[e.to]:
                        dis[e.to] = dis[v] + e.cost + H[v] - H[e.to]
                        PreV[e.to] = v
                        PreE[e.to] = i
                        heapq.heappush(q, (dis[e.to], e.to))
            if dis[t] == float('inf'):
                break
            for i in range(self.V):
                H[i] += dis[i]
            d = f
            v = t
            while v != s:
                d = min(d, self.G[PreV[v]][PreE[v]].capacity)
                v = PreV[v]
            f -= d
            flow += d
            res += d * H[t]
            v = t
            while v != s:
                e = self.G[PreV[v]][PreE[v]]
                e.capacity -= d
                self.G[v][e.rev].capacity += d
                v = PreV[v]
        return res

            self.vis[u] = True
            i = head[u]
            while i:
                v = r[i].to
                w_ = r[i ^ 1].w
                f_ = r[i ^ 1].f
                if f_ and self.dis[u] + self.tag[u] + w_ - self.tag[v] < self.dis[v]:
                    self.dis[v] = self.dis[u] + self.tag[u] + w_ - self.tag[v]
                    heapq.heappush(q, self.Node(v, self.dis[v]))
                i = r[i].nxt
        for i in range(1, self.all + 1):
            self.tag[i] = min(self.tag[i] + self.dis[i], winf)
        if not self.vis[s]:
            return False
        for i in range(1, self.all + 1):
            self.vis[i] = False
        return True

    def dfs(self, u, t, fl):
        if u == t or not fl:
            return fl
        res = 0
        self.vis[u] = True
        i = self.cur[u]
        while i:
            if r[i].f:
                v = r[i].to
                f_ = r[i].f
                if not self.vis[v] and self.tag[v] + r[i].w == self.tag[u]:
                    f = self.dfs(v, t, min(fl, f_))
                    if f:
                        r[i].f -= f
                        r[i ^ 1].f += f
                        res += f
                        fl -= f
                        if not fl:
                            break
            i = r[i].nxt
        self.vis[u] = False
        return res

    def work(self, s, t):
        while self.dij(s, t):
            w = self.dfs(s, t, inf)
            self.maxf += w
            self.minw += w * self.tag[s]

    edges.append(Edge(u, v, cap, cost))

def ford_bellman(s, n):
    for i in range(maxn):
        phi[i] = INF
    phi[s] = 0
    for _ in range(n):
        for j in range(len(edges)):
            e = edges[j]
            if e.cap == e.flow:
                continue
            from_ = e.from_
            to = e.to
            len_ = e.cost
            if phi[from_] == INF:
                continue
            phi[to] = min(phi[to], phi[from_] + len_)

    for i in range(maxn):
        d[i] = INF
    d[s] = 0
    q = []
    heapq.heappush(q, (0, s))

        if dist_v > d[v]:
            continue
        for eid in g[v]:
            e = edges[eid]
            if e.cap == e.flow:
                continue
            to = e.to
            len_ = e.cost + phi[v] - phi[to]
            if d[v] + len_ < d[to]:
                d[to] = d[v] + len_
                par[to] = eid
                heapq.heappush(q, (d[to], to))

    dijkstra(s)

    cost = 0

        pushed = INF
        sum_cost = 0
        tmp = t
        while tmp != s:
            eid = par[tmp]
            e = edges[eid]
            pushed = min(pushed, e.cap - e.flow)
            sum_cost += e.cost
            tmp = e.from_
        flow += pushed

            tmp = edges[eid].from_
        dijkstra(s)
        for i in range(maxn):
            phi[i] = d[i]
    return (cost, flow)

N = 50
M = 50
K = 50
T = N + K + 1
N_ = N * T + 1
M_ = K + (M * 2 * K + N) * (T - 1)
INF = 0x3f3f3f3f

def LT(pi, kk, u, v):
    return pi[u] < pi[v] or (pi[u] == pi[v] and kk[u] < kk[v])

class L:
    def __init__(self, j, next_node=None):
        self.j = j
        self.next = next_node

def add(adj, i, j):
    adj[i] = L(j, adj[i])

def add_(adj, i, h):
    adj[i] = L(h, adj[i])

def i2(i, cnt, pq, iq):
    i *= 2
    if i > cnt:
        return 0
    if i < cnt and LT(pq, iq, pq[i], pq[i + 1]):
        return i + 1
    return i

def pq_up(pq, iq, u):
    i = iq[u]
    while i > 1:
        j = i // 2
        if not LT(pq, iq, u, pq[j]):
            break
        pq[iq[pq[j]]] = i
        pq[i] = pq[j]
        iq[u] = j
        pq[j] = u
        i = j

def pq_dn(pq, iq, u, cnt):
    i = iq[u]
    while True:
        j = i2(i, cnt, pq, iq)
        if j == 0 or not LT(pq, iq, pq[j], u):
            break
        pq[iq[pq[j]]] = i
        pq[i] = pq[j]
        iq[pq[j]] = i
        iq[u] = j
        pq[j] = u
        i = j

def pq_add(pq, iq, u, cnt):
    cnt[0] += 1
    iq[u] = cnt[0]
    pq[cnt[0]] = u
    pq_up(pq, iq, u)

def pq_remove_first(pq, iq, cnt):
    u = pq[1]
    v = pq[cnt[0]]
    cnt[0] -= 1
    if cnt[0] >= 1:
        pq[1] = v
        iq[v] = 1
        pq_dn(pq, iq, v, cnt[0])
    return u

def link(uu, vv, cap, cos, m, cost, cc, aa_, add_, add__):
    h = m[0]
    m[0] += 1
    uu[h] = uu
    vv[h] = vv
    uv = uu ^ vv
    cost[h] = cos
    cc[h << 1] ^ 0 = cap
    add_(add_, uu, h << 1 ^ 0)
    add_(add__, vv, h << 1 ^ 1)

def dijkstra(n_, m_, pi, kk, bb, aa_, cost_, cc, pq, iq, cnt):
    for i in range(n_):
        pi[i] = INF
    pi[s] = 0
    pq_add(pq, iq, s, cnt)
    while cnt[0]:
        u = pq_remove_first(pq, iq, cnt)
        v = None
        l = aa_[u]
        while l:
            h_ = l.j
            if cc[h_]:
                h = h_ >> 1
                p = pi[u] + (cost_[h] if (h_ & 1) == 0 else -cost_[h])
                v_ = u ^ uv[h]
                if pi[v_] == INF:
                    pi[v_] = p
                    kk[v_] = kk[u] + 1
                    bb[v_] = h_
                    pq_add(pq, iq, v_, cnt)
                elif pi[v_] > p or (pi[v_] == p and kk[v_] > kk[u] + 1):
                    pi[v_] = p
                    kk[v_] = kk[u] + 1
                    bb[v_] = h_
                    pq_up(pq, iq, v_)
            l = l.next

def push(s, t, cc, bb, aa_):
    u = t
    while u != s:
        h_ = bb[u]
        h = h_ >> 1
        cc[h_] -= 1
        cc[h_ ^ 1] += 1
        u ^= uv[h]

def edmonds_karp(n_, m_, pi, kk, bb, aa_, cost_, cc, uu, vv, uv, s, t, pq, iq, cnt):
    cost_ = cost_[:m_]
    while True:
        dijkstra(n_, m_, pi, kk, bb, aa_, cost_, cc, pq, iq, cnt)
        if pi[t] == INF:
            break
        push(s, t, cc, bb, aa_)
        for h in range(m_):
            u = uu[h]
            v = vv[h]
            if pi[u] != INF and pi[v] != INF:
                cost_[h] += pi[u] - pi[v]
    c = 0
    for h in range(m_):
        c += cost_[h] * cc[h << 1 ^ 1]
    return c

        add(adj, u, v)

    t = n + k + 1
    n_ = n * t + 1
    m_ = 0
    uu = [0] * M_
    vv = [0] * M_
    uv = [0] * M_
    cost = [0] * M_
    cost_ = [0] * M_
    cc = [0] * (M_ * 2)
    # Initialize arrays for the algorithm
    pi = [0] * n_ 
    kk = [0] * n_
    bb = [0] * n_
    pq = [0] * (n_ + 1)
    iq = [0] * n_
    cnt = [0]
    # Build the graph
    for i in range(n):
        for s in range(t - 1):
            u = i * t + s
            l = adj[i]
            while l:
                j = l.j
                v = j * t + s + 1
                for x in range(1, k + 1):

    for h in range(k):

    s = n_ - 1
    t_node = 0 * t + t - 1
    result = edmonds_karp(n_, m_, pi, kk, bb, adj, cost, cc, uu, vv, uv, s, t_node, pq, iq, cnt)

        f = self.dfs(x, min(flow, self.cap[x][i]))
        self.cap[x][i] -= f
        self.cap[y][j] += f
        return f

class MCMF:
    def __init__(self, n):
        self.n = n
        self.G = [[] for _ in range(n)]
        self.E = []
        self.s = 0
        self.t = 0

    def addEdge(self, u, v, cap, cost):
        self.E.append(Edge(u, v, cap, 0, cost))
        self.E.append(Edge(v, u, 0, 0, -cost))
        m = len(self.E)
        self.G[u].append(m - 2)
        self.G[v].append(m - 1)

    def BelmanFord(self, flow, cost):
        d = [INF] * self.n
        inq = [False] * self.n
        p = [0] * self.n
        a = [0] * self.n

        d[self.s] = 0
        inq[self.s] = True
        p[self.s] = 0
        a[self.s] = INF

        from collections import deque
        Q = deque([self.s])
        while Q:
            u = Q.popleft()
            inq[u] = False
            for i in self.G[u]:
                e = self.E[i]
                if e.cap > e.flow and d[e.v] > d[u] + e.cost:
                    d[e.v] = d[u] + e.cost
                    p[e.v] = i
                    a[e.v] = min(a[u], e.cap - e.flow)
                    if not inq[e.v]:
                        Q.append(e.v)
                        inq[e.v] = True

        if d[self.t] == INF:
            return False, 0, 0
        flow = a[self.t]
        cost = d[self.t]
        u = self.t
        while u != self.s:
            self.E[p[u]].flow += flow
            self.E[p[u]^1].flow -= flow
            u = self.E[p[u]].u
        return True, flow, cost

    def Mincost(self, s, t):
        self.s = s
        self.t = t
        total_flow = 0
        total_cost = 0
        while True:
            found, f, c = self.BelmanFord(total_flow, total_cost)
            if not found:
                break
            total_flow += f
            total_cost += f * c
        return total_flow, total_cost

This problem will be about one of the most popular caching algorithms called LRU (Least Recently Used).Suppose the cache may store no more than k objects. At the beginning of the workflow the cache is empty. When some object is queried we check if it is present in the cache and move it here if it's not. If there are more than k objects in the cache after this, the least recently used one should be removed. In other words, we remove the object that has the smallest time of the last query.Consider there are n videos being stored on the server, all of the same size. Cache can store no more than k videos and caching algorithm described above is applied. We know that any time a user enters the server he pick the video i with probability pi. The choice of the video is independent to any events before.The goal of this problem is to count for each of the videos the probability it will be present in the cache after 10100 queries.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of the input contains two integers n and k (1 ≤ k ≤ n ≤ 20) — the number of videos and the size of the cache respectively. Next line contains n real numbers pi (0 ≤ pi ≤ 1), each of them is given with no more than two digits after decimal point. It's guaranteed that the sum of all pi is equal to 1.
problem_description.output_spec: Print n real numbers, the i-th of them should be equal to the probability that the i-th video will be present in the cache after 10100 queries. You answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed 10 - 6.  Namely: let's assume that your answer is a, and the answer of the jury is b. def solve():
    n, k = map(int, input().split())
    allp = list(map(float, input().split()))
    results = []

    for i in range(n):
        if abs(allp[i]) < 1e-6:
            results.append(0.0)
            continue

        p = [allp[j] for j in range(n) if j != i]
        size = n - 1
        dp = [0.0] * (1 << size)
        dp[0] = allp[i]
        ans = dp[0]

        for mask in range(1, 1 << size):
            sumP = 0.0
            sumVal = 0.0
            cnt = 0
            for t in range(size):
                if mask & (1 << t):
                    sumP += p[t]
                    sumVal += p[t] * dp[mask ^ (1 << t)]
                    cnt += 1
            dp[mask] = sumVal / (1 - sumP) if (1 - sumP) != 0 else 0
            if cnt < k:
                ans += dp[mask]
        results.append(ans)

    print(' '.join(map(str, results)))

class MaxFlow:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.N = size
        self.cap = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
        self.flow = [[0] * size for _ in range(size)]
        self.bfs_par = [-1] * size
        self.bfs_D = [-1] * size

    def add_edge(self, u, v, c=1):
        self.cap[u][v] += c

    def augmenting_path_bfs(self, src, dst, path, mincap=0):
        self.bfs_par = [-1] * self.N
        self.bfs_D = [-1] * self.N
        self.bfs_D[src] = 0
        q = deque([src])
        while q:
            cur = q.popleft()
            if cur == dst:
                cfp = INF
                path.clear()
                path.extend([0] * (self.bfs_D[dst] + 1))
                path[self.bfs_D[dst]] = dst
                curv = dst
                for k in range(self.bfs_D[dst] - 1, -1, -1):
                    prev = self.bfs_par[curv]
                    cfp = min(cfp, self.cap[prev][curv] - self.flow[prev][curv])
                    path[k] = prev
                    curv = prev
                return cfp
            for v in range(self.N):
                if self.bfs_D[v] < 0 and self.cap[cur][v] - self.flow[cur][v] > mincap:
                    self.bfs_D[v] = self.bfs_D[cur] + 1
                    self.bfs_par[v] = cur
                    q.append(v)
        return 0

    def dinic(self, s, t):
        res = 0
        while True:
            path = []
            cfp = self.augmenting_path_bfs(s, t, path)
            if not path:
                break
            # For each node w with residual capacity to t
            for w in range(self.N):
                if self.bfs_D[w] >= 0 and self.cap[w][t] - self.flow[w][t] > 0:
                    cfp = self.cap[w][t] - self.flow[w][t]
                    # Find bottleneck
                    curv = w
                    prev = self.bfs_par[w]
                    while prev >= 0:
                        cfp = min(cfp, self.cap[prev][curv] - self.flow[prev][curv])
                        curv = prev
                        prev = self.bfs_par[prev]
                    self.flow[w][t] += cfp
                    self.flow[t][w] = -self.flow[w][t]
                    curv = w
                    prev = self.bfs_par[w]
                    while prev >= 0:
                        self.flow[prev][curv] += cfp
                        self.flow[curv][prev] = -self.flow[prev][curv]
                        curv = prev
                        prev = self.bfs_par[prev]
                    res += cfp
        return res

class MaxFlow:
    def __init__(self):
        self.to = [0] * MAXM
        self.flow = [0] * MAXM
        self.cap = [0] * MAXM
        self.g = [[] for _ in range(MAXN)]
        self.lastEdge = 0
        self.used = [False] * MAXN

    def addEdge(self, from_, to_, cap):
        self.to[self.lastEdge] = to_
        self.flow[self.lastEdge] = 0
        self.cap[self.lastEdge] = cap
        self.g[from_].append(self.lastEdge)
        self.lastEdge += 1

        self.to[self.lastEdge] = from_
        self.flow[self.lastEdge] = 0
        self.cap[self.lastEdge] = 0
        self.g[to_].append(self.lastEdge)
        self.lastEdge += 1

    def dfs(self, v, T, curFlow):
        if v == T:
            return True
        self.used[v] = True
        for idx in self.g[v]:
            to_ = self.to[idx]
            if not self.used[to_] and self.cap[idx] - self.flow[idx] >= curFlow:
                if self.dfs(to_, T, curFlow):
                    self.flow[idx] += curFlow
                    self.flow[idx ^ 1] -= curFlow
                    return True
        return False

    def getMaxFlow(self, S, T):
        curFlow = 1 << 30
        resFlow = 0
        while curFlow > 0:
            self.used = [False] * MAXN
            if self.dfs(S, T, curFlow):
                resFlow += curFlow
            else:
                curFlow >>= 1
        return resFlow

n = int(input())
T = int(input())

s1 = [list(input().strip()) for _ in range(n)]
s2 = [list(input().strip()) for _ in range(n)]

M = 1000007
N = 210

dir = [ [0, 1], [0, -1], [1, 0], [-1, 0] ]

def inside(x, y):
    return 0 <= x < n and 0 <= y < n and s1[x][y] >= ['0'] and s1[x][y] <= ['9']

# Initialize data structures
vv = [0] * M
nxt = [0] * M
cap = [0] * M
h = [-1] * N
pre = [0] * N
vis = [0] * N
e = 0

def add(u, v, c):
    global e
    vv[e] = v
    nxt[e] = h[u]
    cap[e] = c
    h[u] = e
    e += 1
    vv[e] = u
    nxt[e] = h[v]
    cap[e] = 0
    h[v] = e
    e += 1

q1 = [0] * M
q2 = [0] * M
v1 = [[-1]*15 for _ in range(15)]
v2 = [[-1]*15 for _ in range(15)]

xz, yz = -1, -1
id_map = [[-1]*15 for _ in range(15)]
cnt = 0

for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if s1[i][j] == 'Z':
            xz, yz = i, j
        elif inside(i, j):
            cnt += 1
            id_map[i][j] = cnt

s_node = 0
t_node = 2 * cnt + 1

def bfs(x, y):
    if s2[x][y] != '0':
        add(id_map[x][y] + cnt, t_node, int(s2[x][y]))
    if s1[x][y] == '0':
        return
    add(s_node, id_map[x][y], int(s1[x][y]))
    if s2[x][y] != '0':
        add(id_map[x][y], id_map[x][y] + cnt, 10)

    h1 = 0
    h2 = 0
    t1 = 0
    t2 = 0

    q1[t1] = x
    t1 += 1
    q1[t1] = y
    t1 += 1

    q2[t2] = xz
    t2 += 1
    q2[t2] = yz
    t2 += 1

    up1 = t1
    up2 = t2

    for row in v1:
        for i in range(len(row)):
            row[i] = -1
    for row in v2:
        for i in range(len(row)):
            row[i] = -1

    v1[x][y] = 0
    v2[xz][yz] = 0

    while h1 < t1:
        while h1 < up1:
            x_curr = q1[h1]
            y_curr = q1[h1 + 1]
            h1 += 2
            if v2[x_curr][y_curr] >= 0:
                continue
            for i in range(4):
                x1 = x_curr + dir[i][0]
                y1 = y_curr + dir[i][1]
                if inside(x1, y1) and v1[x1][y1] < 0:
                    v1[x1][y1] = v1[x_curr][y_curr] + 1
                    if v1[x1][y1] > T:
                        break
                    if v2[x1][y1] >= 0:
                        continue
                    q1[t1] = x1
                    t1 += 1
                    q1[t1] = y1
                    t1 += 1
                    if s2[x1][y1] != '0':
                        add(id_map[x][y], id_map[x1][y1] + cnt, 10)
        up1 = t1

        while h2 < up2:
            x_curr = q2[h2]
            y_curr = q2[h2 + 1]
            h2 += 2
            for i in range(4):
                x1 = x_curr + dir[i][0]
                y1 = y_curr + dir[i][1]
                if inside(x1, y1) and v2[x1][y1] < 0:
                    v2[x1][y1] = v2[x_curr][y_curr] + 1
                    q2[t2] = x1
                    t2 += 1
                    q2[t2] = y1
                    t2 += 1
            up2 = t2

def bfs_flow():
    from collections import deque
    q = deque()
    for i in range(N):
        vis[i] = 0
    vis[s_node] = 1
    q.append(s_node)
    while q:
        u = q.popleft()
        i = h[u]
        while i != -1:
            v = vv[i]
            if cap[i] > 0 and not vis[v]:
                pre[v] = i
                if v == t_node:
                    return True
                vis[v] = 1
                q.append(v)
            i = nxt[i]
    return False

def maxFlow():
    total = 0
    while bfs_flow():
        mi = 10**7
        v_curr = t_node
        while v_curr != s_node:
            i = pre[v_curr]
            mi = min(mi, cap[i])
            v_curr = vv[i ^ 1]
        total += mi
        v_curr = t_node
        while v_curr != s_node:
            i = pre[v_curr]
            cap[i] -= mi
            cap[i ^ 1] += mi
            v_curr = vv[i ^ 1]
    return total

# Build the graph
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(n):
        if inside(i, j):
            bfs(i, j)

print(maxFlow())

problem_description.description: This is an easier version of the problem. In this version, $$$n \le 6$$$.Marek is working hard on creating strong testcases to his new algorithmic problem. You want to know what it is? Nah, we're not telling you. However, we can tell you how he generates the testcases.Marek chooses an integer $$$n$$$ and $$$n^2$$$ integers $$$p_{ij}$$$ ($$$1 \le i \le n$$$, $$$1 \le j \le n$$$). He then generates a random bipartite graph with $$$2n$$$ vertices. There are $$$n$$$ vertices on the left side: $$$\ell_1, \ell_2, \dots, \ell_n$$$, and $$$n$$$ vertices on the right side: $$$r_1, r_2, \dots, r_n$$$. For each $$$i$$$ and $$$j$$$, he puts an edge between vertices $$$\ell_i$$$ and $$$r_j$$$ with probability $$$p_{ij}$$$ percent.It turns out that the tests will be strong only if a perfect matching exists in the generated graph. What is the probability that this will occur?It can be shown that this value can be represented as $$$\frac{P}{Q}$$$ where $$$P$$$ and $$$Q$$$ are coprime integers and $$$Q \not\equiv 0 \pmod{10^9+7}$$$. Let $$$Q^{-1}$$$ be an integer for which $$$Q \cdot Q^{-1} \equiv 1 \pmod{10^9+7}$$$. Print the value of $$$P \cdot Q^{-1}$$$ modulo $$$10^9+7$$$.
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of the input contains a single integer $$$n$$$ ($$$\mathbf{1 \le n \le 6}$$$). The following $$$n$$$ lines describe the probabilities of each edge appearing in the graph. The $$$i$$$-th of the lines contains $$$n$$$ integers $$$p_{i1}, p_{i2}, \dots, p_{in}$$$ ($$$0 \le p_{ij} \le 100$$$); $$$p_{ij}$$$ denotes the probability, in percent, of an edge appearing between $$$\ell_i$$$ and $$$r_j$$$.
problem_description.output_spec: Print a single integer — the probability that the perfect matching exists in the bipartite graph, written as $$$P \cdot Q^{-1} \pmod{10^9+7}$$$ for $$$P$$$, $$$Q$$$ defined above.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first sample test, each of the $$$16$$$ graphs below is equally probable. Out of these, $$$7$$$ have a perfect matching:  Therefore, the probability is equal to $$$\frac{7}{16}$$$. As $$$16 \cdot 562\,500\,004 = 1 \pmod{10^9+7}$$$, the answer to the testcase is $$$7 \cdot 562\,500\,004 \mod{(10^9+7)} = 937\,500\,007$$$.

problem_description.description: The game of Egg Roulette is played between two players. Initially 2R raw eggs and 2C cooked eggs are placed randomly into a carton. The shells are left on so there is no way to distinguish a raw egg from a cooked egg. One at a time, a player will select an egg, and then smash the egg on his/her forehead. If the egg was cooked, not much happens, but if the egg was raw, it will make quite the mess. This continues until one player has broken R raw eggs, at which point that player is declared the loser and the other player wins.The order in which players take turns can be described as a string of 'A' and 'B' characters, where the i-th character tells which player should choose the i-th egg. Traditionally, players take turns going one after the other. That is, they follow the ordering "ABABAB...". This isn't very fair though, because the second player will win more often than the first. We'd like you to find a better ordering for the players to take their turns. Let's define the unfairness of an ordering as the absolute difference between the first player's win probability and the second player's win probability. We're interested in orderings that minimize the unfairness. We only consider an ordering valid if it contains the same number of 'A's as 'B's.You will also be given a string S of length 2(R + C) containing only 'A', 'B', and '?' characters. An ordering is said to match S if it only differs from S in positions where S contains a '?'. Of the valid orderings that minimize unfairness, how many match S?
problem_description.input_spec: The first line of input will contain integers R and C (1 ≤ R, C ≤ 20, R + C ≤ 30). The second line of input will contain the string S of length 2(R + C) consisting only of characters 'A', 'B', '?'.
problem_description.output_spec: Print the number of valid orderings that minimize unfairness and match S.
problem_description.notes: NoteIn the first test case, the minimum unfairness is 0, and the orderings that achieve it are "ABBA" and "BAAB", neither of which match S.
